column4: Míng tiān yǒu kǎo shì ma? | Yǒu, shì hàn yǔ kǎo shì, wǒ yǒu diǎnr máng.

column4: Nǐ de shǒu jī zài nǎr? | Zài zhuō zi shàng bian.
column6: 上边: 上 needs its tone (shàng) and suffix 边 is neutral (bian), like 左边/右边 in the word list, not "shang biān"
不见了 uses bare 见, adjacent to taught 看见 and a very common idiom; kept
